evidence_kind_planned: fresh deterministic scripted graph/process execution; not live-model evaluation
learner_prediction: pending at execution; packaging approval does not supply a prediction
phases: Initial invocation pauses for simulated review; no tool body/effect
Fresh worker invokes None without a decision; same pending review and no effect
Fresh worker supplies Command(resume=decision); approved/edit cases exit 86 after durable receiver commit, before tool return; reject ends without tool entry
Fresh worker invokes None after crash; do not supply initial input or another decision
invariants: Fresh OS worker process per phase; distinct recorded PIDs per case
Stable application-generated thread and operation identity, persisted once before the first worker
Same approved payload across tool replay; edit replacement occurs before the first receiver commit
Separate checkpoint SQLite and receiver SQLite transactions; durability sync
Protected replay returns the exact committed receipt and makes no new receiver effect
Unprotected control must demonstrate two committed effects; expected control behavior is not task success
Reject may generate an error ToolMessage but never enters the tool body
Any new approval request after the committed action is an observed contract failure, not manually approved away
Scripted final response derives from the actual ToolMessage; receipt must match committed SQL rows
Actual graph completion, intended single effect, review-policy handling and report honesty are separate verdicts
failure_boundary: One-shot os._exit(86) after receiver record returns and the receipt journal is fsynced, before record_action returns. Not a machine/power-loss simulation.
preflight: Verify receiver and reused source/destination hashes
Record actual loaded dependency versions and selected module hashes; preserve unknown historical revision
Confirm SqliteSaver availability; observed installed metadata is langgraph-checkpoint 4.3.0 and langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.2, not a clean-install proof
Disable tracing; remove key-bearing worker environment; block Python socket operations before runtime imports
Use fresh per-case working directories/databases; no dotenv, live provider, SDK patch or agent-loop replacement
abort_rules: Missing/incompatible dependencies: stop before execution and label setup interruption
Worker failure or timeout: preserve artifacts and classify the reason; do not silently retry or increase budget
Graph-limit stop is a behavior/fixture failure, not silently excluded as provider infrastructure
Any unexpected writes, changed action identity, or duplicate protected effects fail the case
Do not replace scripted responses with a live model; any later live work requires a separate run/token budget
publication: Reviewed phase observations, exits, journal entries and SQL receipts only
No raw checkpoints, unreviewed traces, credentials or private paths
Simulated reviewer source must remain explicit; no human-authentication claim
plan_change_policy: Do not overwrite this frozen v1 after seeing results. Record an amendment/new version before changing criteria; preserve failed attempts.

reuse_sources.runtime_loop: Deep Agents / LangChain / LangGraph, with a deterministic scripted model
